options.description: Each becomes a plumb debug case; the plain defects (1, 2, 6) get fixed and tested on their own branches by the self-debug workflow and land through the merge check. Those that change what plumb is meant to do (3, 4, 5, the guided init) come back to you as questions, as the debug workflow does for a changed meaning.
options.label: Into plumb's fix loop (Recommended)

options.description: You open /plumb intent on them; they are clarified with you, recorded, planned and built together. More of your time, one coherent change.
options.label: One intent loop for all seven

payload.question: Two sessions working in resume-toolkit sent plumb defect reports meant for a 'BOARD.md' that no session here owns: seven problems from that repository's first adoption and intent loop (clarify says ready while questions wait, judge questions without options, questions arriving only at the merge, questions in implementation terms, no way to delegate proof acceptance, generated files flagged untraced, and a six-step plumb init). Where should they go?
